F1: should_block?` does an exact `where(email: email)` match on the raw `params[:email]`, with no normalization in `User`, the validator or the migration, so a mixed-case variant bypasses the blocklist.
F2: should_block?` increments and saves `match_count` inside validation, and `create` runs `user.valid?` then `user.save`, so each blocked attempt counts twice via a non-atomic, unchecked save.
F3: the regex `@(domains)` in the newly added validator file has no end anchor, so `x@whitelisted.com.evil.example` passes the whitelist; the logic was moved by this change, though its behavior predates it.
F4: rejectedEmails: Em.A([])` in the `extend()` literal is a single prototype-level array mutated by `pushObject`, so rejected emails leak across any controller instances.
